product.name: Automated Options Trading Investment Service
product.description: A service that enables affluent Indian investors to invest in automated options trading strategies using their own broker accounts, starting with a minimum capital of ₹4.4 lakhs.

product.name: Financial Calculators Suite
product.description: A collection of online calculators designed to assist users in financial planning and investment decision-making by simplifying complex calculations.

product.name: Research Recommendations Platform
product.description: A technology platform providing access to research reports and trading strategies issued by SEBI-registered research analysts.

product.name: Income Tax Calculator
product.description: An online tool to calculate and compare income tax liabilities under different tax regimes for Indian taxpayers.

product.name: Marriage Goal Planning Calculator
product.description: A calculator designed to help couples collaboratively plan and prioritize their financial and life goals, including retirement and savings targets.
